newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB to issue comment on reported capital increase.
newsitem.headline: NCB to issue comment on reported capital increase.

text.p: Nippon Credit Bank Ltd said on Friday that it would issue a statement at 10.30 a.m. (0130 GMT) on reported details of a plan to increase the bank's capital.
The Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Friday that Nippon Credit Bank's new shares, to be issued as part of a rescue package for the troubled bank, would be priced below the market.

The bank on Tuesday announced restructuring measures aimed at restoring its financial health. It said it hoped the measures, which included halting overseas operations, would boost its capital by 300 billion yen.

Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Tuesday that the ministry had asked the Bank of Japan and a special body administering a fund to wind up failed finance firms for permission to use the fund to buy preferred stock to be issued by NCB.
